prompt.content: Who was disguised as a cameraman during the World Tag Team Championship match at SummerSlam 2003?

output: During the **SummerSlam 2003** World Tag Team Championship match, **The Hurricane** (Eddie Guerrero) was **disguised as a cameraman**. He was seen holding a camera and filming the match from behind the scenes, while his partner Chavo Guerrero was in the ring
